digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend test suite
propositions: Data Center backend has no byte-for-byte value characterization suite equivalent to Cloud's test_backend_characterization.py, only shape-based contract tests that pass with all values wrong
DC's mapper implementations (_map_local_to_dc_fields, _DCOutbound, _DCSanitizer) are separate from Cloud's and have never been pinned to concrete values despite higher risk from recent authorship
The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote is exercised only through AdfCodec in existing tests, never through WikiTextCodec, leaving DC composition regressions undetected
DC's probe classifier cannot be reached through the _backend() fixture seam because FakeTransport.probe_remote returns a static UNREACHABLE result unconditionally
DC's DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES is byte-identical to Cloud's RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, making any parity assertion at defaults vacuous and unable to detect DC binding its own config

Every create-path mapper key (summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee), sanitizer boundary (summary, description, comment), identity label form, and probe branch must be pinned by exact value with mutation verification
